options.markdown:
# Configuration

## Required lookups
- `nist_ai_rmf_subcategories`: NIST AI RMF reference rows.
- `detection_subcategory_map`: ESCU detection-to-RMF mapping.

## Macros
- Configure the AI detection macros for your environment: `mcp_server`, `m365_exported_ediscovery_prompt_logs`, `aws_bedrock_claude`, `ollama_server`, `cisco_ai_defense`.
- Put index, source, and sourcetype constraints in macros.

## Live findings
- The Finding Window controls only live risk/notable panels. Coverage, inventory, and QA panels are lookup based.
- Live panels read `index=risk` and `index=notable`.
- Enable and schedule mapped ESCU detections and enable risk or notable output.
- Supported saved-search title format: `ESCU - <detection_name> - Rule`.

options.query:
| inputlookup nist_ai_rmf_subcategories
| eval rmf_row=1
| fields function category_id subcategory_id subcategory_text rmf_row
| append
    [ | inputlookup detection_subcategory_map
      | eval selected_ai_system=case(len($ai_system_filter|s$)==0 OR $ai_system_filter|s$=="*" OR $ai_system_filter|s$=="__all__" OR match($ai_system_filter|s$, "^\$.*\$$"), "*", true(), $ai_system_filter|s$)
      | where selected_ai_system=="*" OR ai_system==selected_ai_system
      | eval subcategory_ids=split(coalesce(subcategory_ids,""), "|")
      | mvexpand subcategory_ids
      | eval subcategory_id=trim(subcategory_ids)
      | where subcategory_id!=""
      | eval mapped_detection=1
      | eval production_detection=if(lower(coalesce(detection_status,""))=="production", 1, 0)
      | eval mapping_confidence=lower(coalesce(mapping_confidence,"mapped"))
      | eval mapping_state=case(
          mapping_confidence=="validated", "Validated legacy evidence",
          mapping_confidence=="high", "High-confidence mapping",
          mapping_confidence=="medium", "Medium-confidence mapping",
          mapping_confidence=="review", "Review mapping",
          mapping_confidence=="mapped", "Mapped legacy evidence",
          true(), "Mapped evidence")
      | fields subcategory_id detection_name ai_system mapped_detection production_detection mapping_confidence mapping_state mapping_source mapping_reason detection_status detection_type analytic_stories data_sources ]
| stats values(function) as function values(category_id) as category_id values(subcategory_text) as subcategory_text values(detection_name) as detections values(ai_system) as ai_systems dc(detection_name) as detection_count sum(mapped_detection) as mapped_rows sum(production_detection) as production_detections values(mapping_confidence) as mapping_confidence values(mapping_state) as mapping_state values(mapping_source) as mapping_source values(detection_status) as detection_status by subcategory_id
| eval function=mvindex(function,0), category_id=mvindex(category_id,0), subcategory_text=mvindex(subcategory_text,0)
| where isnotnull(function) AND isnotnull(category_id)
| eval detection_count=coalesce(detection_count,0), mapped_rows=coalesce(mapped_rows,0), production_detections=coalesce(production_detections,0)
| eval status=if(detection_count>0,"Covered","No Automated Evidence")
| eval mapping_confidence_text=mvjoin(mapping_confidence,"|")
| eval confidence=case(production_detections>0,"Production detection", match(mapping_confidence_text,"high"),"High-confidence mapping", detection_count>0,"Mapped evidence", true(),"Gap")
| eval selected_function=case($function_filter|s$=="GOVERN" OR $function_filter|s$=="MAP" OR $function_filter|s$=="MEASURE" OR $function_filter|s$=="MANAGE", $function_filter|s$, true(), "*")
| where selected_function=="*" OR function==selected_function
| fields - selected_function
| eval selected_status=case($status_filter|s$=="Covered" OR $status_filter|s$=="No Automated Evidence", $status_filter|s$, true(), "*")
| where selected_status=="*" OR status==selected_status
| fields - selected_status mapping_confidence_text
| table function category_id subcategory_id subcategory_text status confidence detection_count production_detections detections ai_systems mapping_state mapping_source detection_status

search (index=risk OR index=notable)
    [ | inputlookup detection_subcategory_map
      | eval selected_ai_system=$ai_system_filter|s$
      | eval selected_ai_system=case(len(selected_ai_system)==0 OR selected_ai_system=="*" OR selected_ai_system=="__all__" OR match(selected_ai_system, "^\$.*\$$"), "*", true(), selected_ai_system)
      | where selected_ai_system=="*" OR ai_system==selected_ai_system
      | eval savedsearch_title=if(match(detection_name,"^ESCU - .+ - Rule$"), detection_name, "ESCU - ".detection_name." - Rule")
      | eval savedsearch_title=trim(savedsearch_title)
      | where match(savedsearch_title,"^ESCU - [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 _.\-]{0,180} - Rule$")
      | stats values(savedsearch_title) as savedsearch_title dc(savedsearch_title) as savedsearch_count
      | eval quoted="\"".mvjoin(savedsearch_title,"\",\"")."\""
      | eval search=if(savedsearch_count>0, "(source IN (".quoted.") OR search_name IN (".quoted.") OR savedsearch_name IN (".quoted.") OR orig_source IN (".quoted.") OR rule_name IN (".quoted."))", "source=\"__nist_ai_no_match__\"")
      | return $search ]
| eval finding_source=case(index="risk","risk", index="notable","notable", true(),index)
| eval savedsearch_title=coalesce(if(match(search_name,"^ESCU - .+ - Rule$"),search_name,null()), if(match(source,"^ESCU - .+ - Rule$"),source,null()), if(match(savedsearch_name,"^ESCU - .+ - Rule$"),savedsearch_name,null()), if(match(rule_name,"^ESCU - .+ - Rule$"),rule_name,null()), if(match(orig_source,"^ESCU - .+ - Rule$"),orig_source,null()))
| where isnotnull(savedsearch_title)
| rex field=savedsearch_title "^ESCU - (?<detection>.*?)(?: - Rule)?$"
| lookup detection_subcategory_map detection_name as detection OUTPUT ai_system subcategory_ids rmf_function analytic_stories
| where isnotnull(ai_system)
| eval nist_ai_finding_event_id=coalesce(event_id, source_event_id, sid, _cd, tostring(_time)."|".savedsearch_title."|".coalesce(risk_object,"")."|".coalesce(dest,"")."|".coalesce(user,"")."|".coalesce(_raw,""))
| dedup nist_ai_finding_event_id detection
| eval risk_numeric=tonumber(coalesce(calculated_risk_score, risk_score))
| eval severity=case(
    finding_source="risk", lower(coalesce(severity, case(risk_numeric>=80,"critical", risk_numeric>=50,"high", risk_numeric>=20,"medium", risk_numeric>0,"low", true(),"unknown"))),
    finding_source="notable", lower(coalesce(severity, urgency, "unknown")),
    true(), lower(coalesce(severity,"unknown")))
| eval entity=case(
    finding_source="risk", coalesce(risk_object, normalized_risk_object, user, dest, src, host, "unknown"),
    finding_source="notable", coalesce(risk_object, normalized_risk_object, user, dest, src, host, rule_name, "unknown"),
    true(), coalesce(risk_object, normalized_risk_object, user, dest, src, host, "unknown"))
| eval target=case(
    finding_source="risk", coalesce(risk_object_type, dest, src, user, host, ""),
    finding_source="notable", coalesce(dest, src, user, host, ""),
    true(), coalesce(dest, src, user, host, ""))
| eval detail=case(
    finding_source="risk", coalesce(risk_message, source, search_name, detection, ""),
    finding_source="notable", coalesce(rule_description, description, rule_name, detection, ""),
    true(), coalesce(risk_message, rule_description, source, detection, ""))
| eval finding_type=case(finding_source="risk", coalesce(analyticstories, rmf_function, "Risk event"), finding_source="notable", coalesce(rmf_function, "Notable event"), true(), coalesce(rmf_function,"Finding"))
| eval entity=coalesce(entity,"unknown")
| eval source=coalesce(source, finding_source)
| eval target=coalesce(target,"")
| eval detail=substr(coalesce(detail,""),1,500)
| fields _time finding_source ai_system detection finding_type severity entity source target detail

| inputlookup detection_subcategory_map
| where isnotnull(ai_system) AND ai_system!=""
| stats count by ai_system
| sort ai_system

| stats count as total count(eval(status=="Covered")) as covered
| eval pct=if(total=0,0,round(100*covered/total,1))
| fields pct

| stats count(eval(status=="Covered")) as covered
| fields covered

| stats count(eval(status=="No Automated Evidence")) as gaps
| fields gaps

| stats sum(detection_count) as mapped_evidence
| eval mapped_evidence=coalesce(mapped_evidence,0)
| fields mapped_evidence

| stats count by status
| sort status

ds_63nvtA3f.name: Overall Subcategory Coverage - Pie chart search

options.query:
| inputlookup detection_subcategory_map
| eval selected_ai_system=case(len($ai_system_filter|s$)==0 OR $ai_system_filter|s$=="*" OR $ai_system_filter|s$=="__all__" OR match($ai_system_filter|s$, "^\$.*\$$"), "*", true(), $ai_system_filter|s$)
| where selected_ai_system=="*" OR ai_system==selected_ai_system
| where isnotnull(ai_system) AND ai_system!=""
| eval data_sources=coalesce(data_sources, ai_system)
| eval data_source_list=split(data_sources,"|")
| eval subcategory_ids=split(coalesce(subcategory_ids,""), "|")
| eval mapped_subcategories=mvcount(subcategory_ids)
| eval production_detection=if(lower(coalesce(detection_status,""))=="production", 1, 0)
| eval mapping_confidence=lower(coalesce(mapping_confidence,"mapped"))
| eval mapping_confidence=case(mapping_confidence=="high","High confidence", mapping_confidence=="medium","Medium confidence", mapping_confidence=="review","Needs review", mapping_confidence=="validated","Validated legacy", true(),"Mapped")
| stats dc(detection_name) as detections values(data_source_list) as data_sources sum(mapped_subcategories) as mapped_subcategories sum(production_detection) as production_detections values(mapping_confidence) as mapping_confidence by ai_system
| eval data_sources=mvjoin(mvsort(data_sources), ", ")
| eval mapping_confidence=mvjoin(mvsort(mapping_confidence), ", ")
| sort -detections ai_system
| rename ai_system as "AI System", data_sources as "Data Sources", detections as "Detections", mapped_subcategories as "Mapped Subcategories", production_detections as "Production Detections", mapping_confidence as "Mapping Confidence"
| table "AI System" "Data Sources" Detections "Mapped Subcategories" "Production Detections" "Mapping Confidence"

ds_eLy1BISV.name: Current AI Data Sources - Table search

options.query:
| stats count as total count(eval(status=="Covered")) as covered_n by function
| eval coverage_pct=if(total=0,0,round(100*covered_n/total,1))
| eval function_order=case(function="GOVERN",1,function="MAP",2,function="MEASURE",3,function="MANAGE",4,true(),99)
| sort function_order
| table function coverage_pct

ds_hS1OJKg4.name: Coverage % by RMF Function - Column chart search

options.query:
| makeresults
| eval qa_check="Invalid subcategory IDs|Blank AI systems|Blank data sources|Duplicate mappings|Review mappings|Unexpected validated_count|Unsafe detection names"
| makemv delim="|" qa_check
| mvexpand qa_check
| eval issue_count=0, examples=""
| append
    [ | inputlookup detection_subcategory_map
      | eval subcategory_ids=split(coalesce(subcategory_ids,""),"|")
      | mvexpand subcategory_ids
      | eval subcategory_id=trim(subcategory_ids)
      | eval mapped=1
      | fields detection_name ai_system subcategory_id mapped
      | append
          [ | inputlookup nist_ai_rmf_subcategories
            | eval valid_rmf=1
            | fields subcategory_id valid_rmf ]
      | stats max(mapped) as mapped max(valid_rmf) as valid_rmf values(detection_name) as detections by subcategory_id
      | where mapped==1 AND isnull(valid_rmf)
      | eval qa_check="Invalid subcategory IDs", examples=subcategory_id." / ".mvindex(detections,0), issue_count=1
      | fields qa_check issue_count examples ]
| append
    [ | inputlookup detection_subcategory_map
      | where isnull(ai_system) OR trim(ai_system)==""
      | eval qa_check="Blank AI systems", issue_count=1, examples=coalesce(detection_name,"<blank detection>")
      | fields qa_check issue_count examples ]
| append
    [ | inputlookup detection_subcategory_map
      | eval data_sources=coalesce(data_sources,"")
      | where isnull(data_sources) OR trim(data_sources)==""
      | eval qa_check="Blank data sources", issue_count=1, examples=coalesce(detection_name,"<blank detection>")
      | fields qa_check issue_count examples ]
| append
    [ | inputlookup detection_subcategory_map
      | eval subcategory_ids=split(coalesce(subcategory_ids,""),"|")
      | mvexpand subcategory_ids
      | eval subcategory_id=trim(subcategory_ids)
      | stats count as duplicate_count by detection_name ai_system subcategory_id
      | where duplicate_count>1
      | eval qa_check="Duplicate mappings", issue_count=duplicate_count-1, examples=detection_name." / ".ai_system." / ".subcategory_id
      | fields qa_check issue_count examples ]
| append
    [ | inputlookup detection_subcategory_map
      | eval mapping_confidence=lower(coalesce(mapping_confidence,"")), mapping_source=lower(coalesce(mapping_source,""))
      | where mapping_confidence=="review" OR mapping_source=="generated_review"
      | eval qa_check="Review mappings", issue_count=1, examples=coalesce(detection_name,"<blank detection>")." / ".coalesce(mapping_reason,"<no reason>")
      | fields qa_check issue_count examples ]
| append
    [ | inputlookup detection_subcategory_map
      | where isnotnull(validated_count)
      | eval validated_count=trim(tostring(validated_count))
      | where validated_count!="" AND lower(validated_count)!="null" AND NOT match(validated_count,"^[0-9]+$")
      | eval qa_check="Unexpected validated_count", issue_count=1, examples=coalesce(detection_name,"<blank detection>")." / ".validated_count
      | fields qa_check issue_count examples ]
| append
    [ | inputlookup detection_subcategory_map
      | eval expected_savedsearch=if(match(detection_name,"^ESCU - .+ - Rule$"), detection_name, "ESCU - ".detection_name." - Rule")
      | eval expected_savedsearch=trim(expected_savedsearch)
      | where NOT match(expected_savedsearch,"^ESCU - [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 _.\-]{0,180} - Rule$")
      | eval qa_check="Unsafe detection names", issue_count=1, examples=coalesce(detection_name,"<blank detection>")
      | fields qa_check issue_count examples ]
| stats sum(issue_count) as Issues values(examples) as examples by qa_check
| eval examples=mvfilter(examples!="")
| eval Examples=mvjoin(mvindex(examples,0,5), "; ")
| rename qa_check as "QA Check"
| table "QA Check" Issues Examples
| sort -Issues "QA Check"

| where status=="No Automated Evidence"
| stats count as gaps values(subcategory_id) as subcategories by function category_id
| rename function as Function, category_id as Category, gaps as Gaps, subcategories as Subcategories
| sort -Gaps Function Category

ds_7kk8BZgQ.name: Coverage Gaps by Category - Table search

options.query:
| eval coverage_score=case(confidence=="Production detection",100, confidence=="High-confidence mapping",80, confidence=="Mapped evidence",60, true(),0)
| eval function_order=case(function="GOVERN",1,function="MAP",2,function="MEASURE",3,function="MANAGE",4,true(),99)
| sort function_order category_id subcategory_id
| rename function as Function, category_id as Category, subcategory_id as Subcategory, coverage_score as "Coverage Score", confidence as Confidence, detection_count as Detections, production_detections as "Production Detections", ai_systems as "AI Systems", subcategory_text as "Subcategory Text", mapping_state as "Mapping State", detection_status as "Detection Status", status as Status
| table Function Category Subcategory "Coverage Score" Confidence Detections "Production Detections" "AI Systems" "Mapping State" "Detection Status" "Subcategory Text" Status

ds_Twm3TjaW.name: NIST AI RMF Coverage Detail - Table search

options.query:
| inputlookup detection_subcategory_map
| eval selected_ai_system=case(len($ai_system_filter|s$)==0 OR $ai_system_filter|s$=="*" OR $ai_system_filter|s$=="__all__" OR match($ai_system_filter|s$, "^\$.*\$$"), "*", true(), $ai_system_filter|s$)
| where selected_ai_system=="*" OR ai_system==selected_ai_system
| where isnotnull(ai_system) AND ai_system!=""
| eval mapping_confidence=lower(coalesce(mapping_confidence,"mapped"))
| eval mapping_confidence=case(mapping_confidence=="high","High confidence", mapping_confidence=="medium","Medium confidence", mapping_confidence=="review","Needs review", mapping_confidence=="validated","Validated legacy", true(),"Mapped")
| stats count as detections by ai_system mapping_confidence
| chart sum(detections) over ai_system by mapping_confidence
| fillnull value=0

ds_985blmZV.name: Mapping Confidence by AI System - Bar chart search

options.query:
| chart count over ai_system by severity
| appendpipe
    [ | stats count as result_count
      | where result_count==0
      | eval ai_system="No live findings", info=0
      | fields - result_count ]
| fillnull value=0

ds_GuKtVyMD.name: Recent Finding Volume - Column chart search

options.query:
| timechart count by ai_system
| appendpipe
    [ | stats count as result_count
      | where result_count==0
      | eval _time=now(), "No live findings"=0
      | fields _time "No live findings" ]
| fillnull value=0

ds_baqBk8nw.name: Recent Findings Over Time - Line chart search

options.query:
| stats count as findings dc(detection) as detection_types values(ai_system) as ai_systems values(severity) as severities values(finding_source) as finding_sources max(_time) as last_time by entity
| eval lastSeen=strftime(last_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
| rename entity as Entity, findings as Findings, detection_types as "Detection Types", ai_systems as "AI Systems", severities as Severities, finding_sources as "Finding Sources", lastSeen as "Last Seen"
| sort -Findings
| table Entity Findings "Detection Types" "AI Systems" Severities "Finding Sources" "Last Seen"
| appendpipe
    [ | stats count as result_count
      | where result_count==0
      | eval Entity="No live findings", Findings=0, "Detection Types"="Enable and schedule mapped AI detections", "AI Systems"="Check Live Findings Readiness", Severities="info", "Finding Sources"="risk/notable", "Last Seen"="No events in selected Finding Window"
      | fields - result_count ]

| eval eventTime=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
| sort -_time
| rename finding_source as source_type
| table eventTime source_type ai_system severity entity detection target detail
| appendpipe
    [ | stats count as result_count
      | where result_count==0
      | eval eventTime="", source_type="Configuration", ai_system="No live findings", severity="info", entity="No risk/notable events in selected window", detection="Enable and schedule mapped AI detections", target="", detail="All mapped detections are disabled or no risk/notable output has been generated. Check Live Findings Readiness."
      | fields - result_count ]

| inputlookup detection_subcategory_map
| eval selected_ai_system=case(len($ai_system_filter|s$)==0 OR $ai_system_filter|s$=="*" OR $ai_system_filter|s$=="__all__" OR match($ai_system_filter|s$, "^\$.*\$$"), "*", true(), $ai_system_filter|s$)
| where selected_ai_system=="*" OR ai_system==selected_ai_system
| eval expected_savedsearch=if(match(detection_name,"^ESCU - .+ - Rule$"), detection_name, "ESCU - ".detection_name." - Rule")
| eval expected_savedsearch=trim(expected_savedsearch)
| where match(expected_savedsearch,"^ESCU - [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 _.\-]{0,180} - Rule$")
| eval mapped=1
| fields ai_system data_sources detection_name expected_savedsearch mapped
| append
    [ | rest /servicesNS/-/-/saved/searches splunk_server=local
      | rename title as expected_savedsearch
      | eval savedsearch_present=1
      | eval enabled=if(disabled==0 OR disabled=="0","Enabled","Disabled")
      | eval scheduled=if(is_scheduled==1 OR is_scheduled=="1","Scheduled","Not scheduled")
      | eval finding_output=case(match(actions,"(^|,)risk(,|$)") OR 'action.risk'==1 OR 'action.risk'=="1","Risk", match(actions,"(^|,)notable(,|$)") OR 'action.notable'==1 OR 'action.notable'=="1","Notable", true(),"No risk/notable")
      | eval schedule=coalesce(cron_schedule,""), window=coalesce('dispatch.earliest_time',"")." to ".coalesce('dispatch.latest_time',"")
      | fields expected_savedsearch savedsearch_present enabled scheduled finding_output schedule window ]
| stats max(mapped) as mapped values(ai_system) as ai_system values(data_sources) as data_sources values(detection_name) as detection_name max(savedsearch_present) as savedsearch_present values(enabled) as enabled values(scheduled) as scheduled values(finding_output) as finding_output values(schedule) as schedule values(window) as window by expected_savedsearch
| where mapped==1
| eval present=if(savedsearch_present==1,"Present","Missing")
| eval enabled=coalesce(mvindex(enabled,0),"Missing")
| eval scheduled=coalesce(mvindex(scheduled,0),"Missing")
| eval finding_output=coalesce(mvindex(finding_output,0),"Missing")
| eval readiness=case(present=="Missing","Missing saved search", enabled!="Enabled","Disabled", scheduled!="Scheduled","Not scheduled", finding_output=="No risk/notable","No risk/notable action", true(),"Ready")
| eval data_sources=mvjoin(mvsort(data_sources),", ")
| eval schedule=coalesce(mvindex(schedule,0),""), window=coalesce(mvindex(window,0),"")
| sort readiness ai_system detection_name
| rename ai_system as "AI System", detection_name as Detection, expected_savedsearch as "Saved Search", readiness as Readiness, finding_output as "Finding Output", schedule as Schedule, window as Window, data_sources as "Data Sources"
| table "AI System" Detection "Saved Search" Readiness "Finding Output" Schedule Window "Data Sources"

description: Maps AI-related ESCU detections and ESCU-generated risk/notable findings to NIST AI RMF subcategories for coverage review, gap analysis, and operational follow-up. Coverage is generated from detection metadata and configured AI data-source selectors; live findings are limited to standard ESCU rule saved-search output in the form ESCU - <detection_name> - Rule. The mapping is practitioner-maintained operational guidance and is not an official NIST or Splunk taxonomy.
title: NIST AI RMF Control Coverage
